<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex04012026-09-0202-01-11" status="unreviewed">yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3921">tho</rs> na re chos kyi byes kyi ngo bo sngar la mthog
            pa mthong ma yin pa nas dra ba laso pa na chos kyi dbyings kyi ldog pa sngar ma mtho' ba
            mthong ba yod kyang chos kyi dbyigs kyi ngo bo sngar ma mthong ba mthong ga pas mthong
            pa du mar mi 'gyur ro zhes <expan>zer ro</expan> || </seg></TEI>
